notes: **Third v0.3 feature**: precise GC stack maps (shadow-stack fallback shape per scope-down option in brief). Replaces M9 conservative `in_jit: AtomicUsize` pause with per-thread shadow-stack root enumeration so GC can collect during JIT'd execution. New vm/src/stackmap_registry.rs: thread-local Vec<(buf len)> with rt_shadow_push / rt_shadow_pop extern "C" helpers. vm/src/jit.rs: each JIT'd function allocates per-function Cranelift stack slot sized to its register file; before every heap-allocating runtime helper (rt_alloc / rt_list_* / rt_array_new / rt_virtual_call / CallDirect / CallNative / strictpy_alloc_str_const) the JIT spills every register variable into the slot and pushes the (buf len) window then pops after the helper returns. vm/src/interp.rs::maybe_collect snapshots the per-thread shadow stack and feeds every published window into Heap::collect's root scan. The in_jit field its bracket calls in op_call_direct and the early-return in maybe_collect are GONE.
